authenticity_review: High-quality AI generation with excellent lighting, composition, and texture detail. Minor anatomical simplifications exist: left giraffe rear leg joints appear slightly stiff/thin, hooves lack fine keratin detail and show mild ground fusion, and the transition from patterned skin to white lower legs is somewhat abrupt. These are severity-2 issues that do not significantly detract from overall realism. No noise, blur, or compression artifacts detected.
key_defects: Simplified joint articulation in left giraffe rear legs
Hooves lack fine detail and show slight ground fusion
Abrupt texture transition on lower legs
